page: Microsoft Azure D48nds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dndv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 Intel processor architecture. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage requirements, the server includes 2835 GB of NVMe SSD capacity and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. This high-speed local storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering low-latency data access. The instance does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local NVMe SSD storage, this server is designed for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, and network-intensive applications. It offers a resource-dense hardware profile suitable for enterprise applications requiring dedicated CPU resources and fast local scratch space without the need for hardware acceleration.
